n: Demystifying AI OER collection of unplugged activities
t: An open collection of unplugged AI activities described in Hello World issue 28.
steps: Find Hello World issue 28 from the Raspberry Pi Foundation.
Read the article on pages 70 to 73.
Look for the collection link in the article.
Note that the FAU record gives no direct link to the collection.
Compare the collection with the five activities at aiunplugged.org. The research team could not confirm that they are the same.
Choose one activity and print what it needs.
Check the license terms before sharing copies.
